body:
## Council question

Does the Karama chapter correctly reproduce the current per-faction interaction list and its declaration windows?

## Settled rule

Norbert confirmed on 5 October 2026 that Dreamrules Karama suppression lasts for the full phase. Duration is settled. Older wording that says "this turn" or "the rest of the turn" does not reopen that question.

## Current evidence

Quickstart v0.8 points to a Karama Interactions appendix absent from the supplied document. The current faction sheets do contain interaction text in `rules.advantages[].karama`. The draft now compiles those entries for all eight finished factions.

## Answer needed

Review the transcribed consequences and declaration windows. Confirm any corrections to specific abilities. The chapter distinguishes Cyborg immunity from stopping Suboid casualty substitution, and distinguishes suppression from Karama's auction and shipment uses.

## Draft

[Karama chapter](https://dune.zone/rulesets/dreamrules/rulebooks/dream-rulebook/edit#KARA/details), followed by timing examples and five faction-reference pages.

This chapter is based on current faction data. The completeness and individual windows of the matrix have not yet received council verification. That review is the remaining scope of this ticket.

## Sources

Quickstart v0.8, Full Phase Karama; the eight current Dreamrules faction sheets; Norbert's direct full-phase confirmation on 5 October 2026.

Part of #1831. Record corrections with a worked example before closing. Norbert can share this link with the council; this ticket does not send them a message.

comments.body:
The draft now has a seven-page Karama chapter, including the current faction-sheet interaction list for all eight finished factions. The source of this list is each live faction's `rules.advantages[].karama`, rather than an older appendix.

Norbert confirmed on 5 October 2026 that Karama suppression in Dreamrules lasts for the full phase. This is settled. Older faction fields saying "this turn" or "the rest of the turn" have been normalized to the current phase in the chapter; duration is not a council question.

The remaining scope of this ticket is review of the full interaction list and its specific declaration windows. The chapter distinguishes stopping an advantage from taking an auction card or discounting a shipment. It also distinguishes Cyborg immunity from stopping Suboid casualty substitution.

Draft: https://dune.zone/rulesets/dreamrules/rulebooks/dream-rulebook/edit#KARA/details

The book remains a Central-owned draft. No new edition was published.

title: Dreamrules ruling: Which current faction advantages can Karama stop, and at which windows?
